reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness marketplace focused on searching and inspecting a plugin index, preparing user-confirmed installations, and contributing issue reports and feedback.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索和查看插件，并在用户确认后准备安装、提交问题报告和分享使用反馈。
summaries.en: Search and inspect DeepSeek Harness plugins, then prepare user-confirmed installations and share issue reports or usage feedback.

capabilities: Searches and inspects an indexed catalog of DeepSeek Harness plugins
Prepares an explicit install handoff for a selected plugin
Creates and submits redacted GitHub or Gitee issue reports with user confirmation
Submits optional plugin scores, FAQ answers, and pitfall reports
